Q185489.sql:
SELECT lang,page_id,rev_id,title,row_start AS revised_at,
 CHAR_LENGTH(text) AS characters FROM revision FOR SYSTEM_TIME ALL
 WHERE lang=%s AND page_id=%s ORDER BY row_start DESC LIMIT 40
